content: The TcpIp shall support the frame format for transmission of IPv6 packets and the method of forming IPv6 link - local addresses and statelessly autoconfigured addresses on Ethernet networks as defined in IETF RFC 2464 (Transmission of IPv6 Packets over Ethernet Networks).
